hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Count up "turnInBattle".
If condition flag "protect_done" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isUsedProtect' to true.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If not the register's 'isUsedProtect' and the count "turnInBattle" is at least the numeric entry "turn_of_use_protect" in aiArg, then the enemy uses the move labelled "protect".
  Otherwise, the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2.
Let damageInfo be arg2's 'damage'.
If not (arg2 meets the damage condition call game:ai.AiHookUtil.adjustDamage.getCommonDamageObjectCondition with (game:Conf.AI_HOOK_ADJUST_DAMAGE_TYPE.ALL)), then return damageInfo.
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the acting enemy.
Let data be {ability: {reasonStatusAilmentId: the POISON status}}.
If arg2 meets the damage condition data, then return damageInfo times the numeric entry "damage_up_rate_poison" in aiArg divided by 100.
Otherwise, return damageInfo.
